facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's sector plan HSSDP III covers 2022 to 2026, is dated October 2021 and was launched on 28 April 2022 per the record's note, and treats the HMIS and DHIS2 in its Data and Information section (2.6.6, not captured verbatim).

facts.fact: HSSDP III, as summarised in the record's note (section not captured verbatim), states that DHIS2 had been rolled out to about 40 per cent of facilities at secondary level and above, while data is collected from all health facilities through paper and electronic channels; no numerator or denominator is given.
